name_reason: Name follows the data_fd2_battle_* convention for a battle-core global, accurately describes the datum (enemy-AI selected best item-use target tile Y coordinate), and carries no Ghidra address residue. The trailing 'y' is the axis semantic, not an address. Consistent with its sibling result-group members (ai_best_item_target_x/slot/score) and the spell analogue ai_best_spell_target_y.
purpose: Enemy-AI best item-use target tile Y coordinate; second member of the ai_best_item_* result group selected by fd2_ai_score_item_use and consumed by fd2_execute_ai_item_use.
logic_summary: Zero-init BSS dword scalar @0x53C3B. fd2_ai_score_item_use writes it (@0x1581A) with the winning candidate tile Y (a byte tile coordinate zero-extended via MOVZX @0x15841) when a candidate's score beats ai_best_item_score. fd2_execute_ai_item_use reads it (@0x150E5/0x15108/0x1514F/0x1527B) to drive AoE/line targeting and cursor panning; for the long-range projectile path it rewrites the value in-place during interpolation toward the caster's world position (@0x15249/0x1525C/0x15267) and signed-clamps it to [0, data_fd2_battle_map_height_tiles-1].
element_semantics: Single dword holding an unsigned battle-map tile Y coordinate (row index); source values are byte tile coords zero-extended to dword. During the long-range item path it is overwritten with an interpolated tile Y and clamped signed to the map height range.
notes: All comment claims cross-checked against disassembly: writer MOV [0x53C3B],EAX @0x1581A with MOVZX byte source @0x15841; readers (PUSH dword [0x53C3B]) @0x150E5/0x15108/0x1514F/0x1527B; in-place rewrites @0x15249 (interp), @0x1525C (clamp-high DEC), @0x15267 (clamp-low =0); clamp compares against data_fd2_battle_map_height_tiles @0x53AC5 with signed JL/JGE. Ghidra data plate at 0x53C3B was empty (verified <null>); created a concise plate via PLATE_COMMENT (run_script_inline). No src edit: existing comment block in btl_ai.c is already accurate and precise (keep). No rename applied (Stage 2).
